storage: Cool, dry cupboard, tightly closed. It solidifies in cold weather; this is normal and reversible by warming the bottle.
looksLike: Clear, colourless liquid with a coconut smell; it turns white and solid below about 24 °C.
howToPick: Clear, with a clean coconut smell and a sealed cap; check that the label says edible. Avoid a sour or rancid smell and cloudy liquid in warm weather.
shelfLife: About a year unopened; use within 3–6 months once opened (general guidance, not from a source in this run).

usedIn.raw: 10 ml (about 9 g, 2 tsp) per serving; 5 ml in the lower-oil version
